project.title: Sun Metals Z20 — Robotic Ingot-Stacking Cell
project.safety_classification: E-Stop major-fault path (site safety controller scope not in this program)
project.fault_philosophy: 14-word fault table (TOP.CTRL.Fault[0..13]). E-Stop (F0.30/F0.31) = MajorFault forcing all EMs to aborted; other conditions latch as minor faults until Fault_Reset_Request.
design_principles: PackML-style unit state model (custom BASE_CONTROL on the TOP tag).
Reusable device AOIs (FB_DI_Sensor / FB_AI_Sensor / FB_DI_PushButton / FB_D_Solenoid) as control modules.
PGNO program-number handshake to the KUKA robot for all motion.
Reverse-engineered from L5K; robot motion detail resides in the KUKA .src.
scope_exclusions: Strapping_Machine / OLD_Strapping_Machine / Channel1Program (other units on the same controller).
Slab_1_M580 CIP bridge (not referenced by KUKA_ROBOT program).
KUKA .src robot motion programs (referenced by PGNO only).

units.description: KUKA KRC5 robot cell palletising cast aluminium ingots into layered, strapped stacks. One Unit within the Z20 strapping line (controller Sun_Metals_Z20).

equipment_modules.description: Detects ingots at 4 conveyor pickup positions, classifies Foot/Standard/Top/Flip, maintains the FIFO infeed queue and tracking array, deletes picked ingots and drives the turn-over flipper. Source: R201/R202/R203 + FB_INGOT_DETECTION, FB_IngotDetect_Scan.

control_modules.description: Balluff BNI006A EtherNet/IP IO-Link master — 8 ports: P1–P4 IO-Link (laser + DI), P5–P8 DI.
Balluff BNI006A EtherNet/IP IO-Link master — 8 ports DI (sensors 13–22).

equipment_modules.description: Maps the full KUKA KRC5 EtherNet/IP handshake, selects and dispatches the robot task via the PGNO program-number interface, enforces ready/interlock conditions and reflects robot status to PLC/HMI. Source: R004/R204 + FB_EXECUTE_R_STEPS_ACTIONS, AOI_KRC5_KUKA.

control_modules.description: KUKA KRC5 robot controller — PGNO task dispatch, drives/enable handshake, gripper ops, stack/makeup reflections.

equipment_modules.description: Step/action sequence placing foot ingots onto the active stack; assigns active stack, dispatches robot tasks, advances CurrentLayer/NextLayer. Source: FOOT_SAS/FOOT_SECTION step-action FB.
Step/action sequence placing regular ingots onto the active stack; assigns active stack, dispatches robot tasks, advances CurrentLayer/NextLayer. Source: REGULAR_SAS/REGULAR_SECTION step-action FB.
Step/action sequence placing top ingots onto the active stack; assigns active stack, dispatches robot tasks, advances CurrentLayer/NextLayer. Source: TOP_SAS/TOP_SECTION step-action FB.

Per-stack layer/quantity counting, active-stack rotation, stack-off-conveyor shift to the strapper, and X-position tracking via the SICK encoder. Source: R301 + STACK_COUNT, MAKEUP_COUNT, FB_OUTFEED_ENC_TRACK.

control_modules.description: SICK AFM60A EtherNet/IP absolute encoder — tracks stack X-position during indexing (read via explicit MSG).

equipment_modules.description: Partial-layer buffer holding top/mid/btm racks with required quantity per option; fills when no stack is active. Source: MAKEUP_TABLE/MAKEUP_1 + makeup fill logic in R203.
4 gripper solenoids (extend/retract with reed-switch feedback) + laser air-blast, driven by the robot's gripper open/close ops via the SMC EX260 valve manifold. Source: R003/R008 + FB_D_Solenoid.

control_modules.description: SMC EX260-SEN1 EtherNet/IP valve manifold — 5 solenoid points: grippers A–D + air-blast.
Gripper A extend/retract (FB_DO_SolenoidData[1]) with reed-switch feedback.

equipment_modules.description: 6-step handshake (via robot Task 6) releasing a completed stack to the downstream ConveyTech conveyor / strapper. Mediated through the robot (KUKA_ROBOT.In.CONVEYOR_*). Source: R305.

alarm_tiers.description: Minor fault; latches until reset, may stop the cycle.
Major fault / E-Stop; forces EMs to safe (aborted).

idle.notes: Queue frozen while system not running (RunSYS false).

steps.name: Detect & classify

actions.text: Classify ingot per position via FB_INGOT_DETECTION and laser height scan.
actions.prose: Classify ingot per position via FB_INGOT_DETECTION and laser height scan.

steps.action: Read per-position top/foot sensors + laser scan; FB_INGOT_DETECTION classifies each position as Foot(1)/Standard(2)/Top/Flip(3).
steps.completion_criteria_text: Ingot type resolved for each active position

steps.name: Insert into queue

actions.text: Append ingot type to INFEED_Queue and INFEED_INGOT_TRAKING.
actions.prose: Append ingot type to INFEED_Queue and INFEED_INGOT_TRAKING.

steps.action: Insert classified ingot type into INFEED_Queue at the insert index; append to tracking array; raise INFEED_Alarm_Ingot_unexpected if type != expected.

steps.name: Delete on pick
steps.action: When a stack section signals ACTIONS.7 (picked), delete taken ingots from the queue and compact (R202 FOR loop).

execute.notes: Turn-over flipper path (INFEED_KUKA_Turn_Over_Flipper, triggered after 36 tracked / every 4 tops) is heuristic — confirm intended rule.

idle.notes: Awaiting a task request; robot at home / PERI_RDY.

steps.name: Select task

actions.text: Move selected task number to KUKA_ROBOT.Out.PGNO.
actions.prose: Move selected task number to KUKA_ROBOT.Out.PGNO.

steps.action: Latch the requested task number (1..8) into Task_Request from the active stack section / HMI IN_TASK_n_EXE.

steps.name: Handshake PGNO

actions.prose: Assert PGNO valid to release the robot program.

steps.action: On KUKA_ROBOT.In.PGNO_REQ, assert PGNO_VALID; robot acknowledges and starts the program.

steps.name: Await completion
steps.action: Robot runs task (move/pick/place/dump). Wait for task-completed handshake (PGNO_REQ low & APPL_RUN).

steps.name: Clear request
steps.action: Clear Task_Request; update Last_Run_Task; hand back to the calling stack section.

execute.notes: Task map (PGNO): 1=move-to-pick, 2=stack-with-makeup, 3/4=stack variants, 5=send-data, 6=conveytech-release, 7=maintenance. Tasks 3/4 motion detail lives in the KUKA .src — [ASSUMPTION].

idle.notes: Awaiting a full pickup queue for this ingot type.

steps.name: Request pick
steps.action: Assert ACTIONS.2 → robot Task 1 (move to position); activate grippers per LOCn_PICK.

steps.name: Place on stack
steps.action: Robot places ingots on the active stack at CurrentLayer; ACTIONS.4 sends stack data to robot.

steps.name: Update layer

actions.text: Advance NextLayer and mark Foot/Reg/Top layer complete on the active stack.
actions.prose: Advance NextLayer and mark Foot/Reg/Top layer complete on the active stack.

steps.action: ACTIONS.7 marks layer complete, deletes picked ingots from the infeed queue, advances NextLayer; rotate active stack when CurrentLayer >= 10.

execute.notes: Foot layer is the bottom layer; ACTIONS map: 2=pick,4=send-data,7=update,11=Task2,20=Task3,26=Task4.

execute.notes: Top layer uses flip-detected ingots; gated by CurrentLayer==9 & laser slot==1.

steps.name: Count layers
steps.action: STACK_COUNT per stack maintains CurrentLayer/counts; mark Complete when CurrentLayer >= 10.

steps.name: Rotate on off-conveyor
steps.action: On StackOffConeyor, shift STACK[2]→[1], [3]→[2] (backups forward).

steps.name: Track index position
steps.action: FB_OUTFEED_ENC_TRACK integrates encoder delta into STACK[n].X_Position_Act during index.

idle.notes: Only active when all 3 stacks inactive or a fill is requested.

steps.name: Fill racks
steps.action: Accumulate ingots to RequiredFeet/RequiredRegular per MAKEUP_TABLE.Option (1: 11 feet/3 reg; 2: 4 feet/10 reg).

execute.notes: Required quantities per option are constants in R301 — confirm whether product-configurable.

idle.notes: Default hold when robot issues no gripper op.

steps.name: Follow robot ops
steps.action: Grippers extend/retract following KUKA_ROBOT.In.GRIPPER_x_OPN/CLS_OP; feedback echoed back as reed-switch status.

completion_criteria.prompt: Gripper motion follows robot open/close ops

idle.notes: Awaiting a completed stack (StackOffConeyor) or robot CONVEYOR_INT.

steps.name: Trigger
steps.action: Step 0→1 on Triger_CONVE_INT (robot CONVEYOR_INT or StackOffConeyor).

steps.name: Call Task 6
steps.action: Step 1→2: request robot Task 6 (MOV 6 → Task_Request).

steps.name: Output on
steps.action: Step 2→3→4: assert Output_CONVE_INT to the downstream conveyor.

steps.name: Output off & finish
steps.action: Step 5→6→31→0: drop output, complete handshake, return to idle.
